title: The reading room
starting_code:
# This works, but it writes the same number three times. Give the number a name!
wizard.move_right(3)
wizard.move_up(3)
wizard.move_right(3)
hints: We want to use the number `3` many times.
Use the `=` sign. Put the number `3` under a name like `steps`.
Write the name inside the brackets of the actions.
intro: Welcome to the library, {wizard}. This is the reading room. My program here works. But we can make it tidier.
outro: Very well done! A tidy program is easier to read.
learned: Now you know how to give a name to a value, which programmers call a variable.
